facts.text: Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) 3% Face Toner
Tightens Pores, Exfoliates, Hydrates & Rebalances Skin Microbiome

A daily, gentle exfoliating, pH balancing, pore tightening & skin hydrating toner. Boosted with Pre-Biotics and Pro-Biotics to balance skin microbiome and accelerate the recovery of skin's barrier function.
"There's a lot of misconception about how toners are not needed. This one has reduced the visibility of my pores. It works really well with my SA cleanser. -Keerthi P."
Formulated for all skin types. This toner is very lightweight and glides on the skin effortlessly before absorbing quickly & completely
PHAs are next generation AHAs. They not just exfoliate gently, but also functions as humectants. Further, Gluconolactone (PHA used in this formula) provides up to 50% protection against UV radiation
Formulated with Prebiotics and Probiotics to balance skin microbiome and enhance natural defence barriers of the skin. Also boosted with multiple humectants for multi-level hydration
High quality ingredients including Gluconolactone sourced from Jungbunzlauer, Switzerland and Prorenew Complex CLR from CLR Chemisches, Germany
Skin type: Dry/Normal, Sensitive, Oily, Combination, Acne-Prone
Suitable for: 18+ years of age
Concerns: Enlarged pores, Dehydrated skin or Uneven texture
This toner helps remove dead skin cells / built up left after cleansing. It also prepares the skin for the serums to follow and helps in improving active delivery
90% subjects agreed pore size got reduced after 4 weeks
93% subjects agreed skin felt hydrated immediately on application
90% subjects agreed skin texture felt smoother after 3 weeks
Note: The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.

SHAKE WELL BEFORE USE. After cleansing, take few drops of toner into palms & gently press into face & neck until fully absorbed. Do not rinse off. Can be applied with cotton pads as well. Layer it with your preferred serums & moisturizer.
When to use: AM & PM. Everyday.

PHAs are next generation AHAs. Because of its larger molecule size compared to Glycolic acid (molecular weight 178 vs. 76 for Glycolic acid), it penetrates the skin slowly, hence offering gentle exfoliation without causing any skin irritation
Topical applications of probiotics directly affect the skin by enhancing its natural defense barriers. This product uses both forms of biotic (pre & pro) to restore skin’s natural health and beauty
The duo helps to reduce the appearance of enlarged pores, keeps your oil in check, gently exfoliates your skin, & prevents clogged pores giving you a flawless, matt look

Water/Aqua, Methylpropanediol, Gluconolactone, PEG/PPG-17/6 Copolymer, Ethoxydiglycol, Niacinamide, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Inulin, Lactococcus Ferment Lysate, Xylitylglucoside, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Salicylic Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Allantoin, Sodium Polyglutamate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Pentylene Glycol, Lysine, Histidine, Arginine, Aspartic Acid, Threonine, Serine, Glutamic Acid, Proline, Glycine, Alanine, Valine, Methionine, Isoleucine, Leucine, Tyrosine, Phenylalanine, Cysteine, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Citric Acid, Propylene Glycol, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate

Yes. It's a gentle, hydrating toner and can be used every day AM and PM or as per your skin needs. When used during the day, always wear a broad spectrum sunscreen SPF 30 or above to avoid sun sensitivity.

facts.section: Can it be used on acne-prone skin?
facts.text: Yes. It's a pH-balancing toner and contains Niacinamide and Salicylic Acid. Both these ingredients are helpful in reducing excess sebum and reducing acne, and this combination makes this toner ideal for combination / oily, acne-prone skin.

facts.section: What is the recommended age for using this toner?
facts.text: Scientifically, it is safe for a younger age, but to avoid overconsumption and any undesirable effects, we recommend it for teens and adults (Above 18 years).
Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should not use this product without consulting their healthcare provider first.
